# 2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)

Generated by `npm run build` from the feature files in `src/components/` and the step definitions in `src/tests/_shared-steps/`. Edit those, not this file.

Level AAA. [Understanding 2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced) on w3.org](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-not-obscured-enhanced.html).

Scenarios: automatic.

## Setup

- [`Given I load the sample "<input-url>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/1-Given/samples-load.js) — Loads a sample to test from a web URL.
- [`When I focus "<selector>" using a keyboard`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element using the keyboard. Note: Will activate :focus-visible styles.
- [`When I click on "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/mouse-events-occur.js) — Clicks an element with the primary mouse button
- [`When I focus a link behind "<selector>" using a keyboard`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses a link behind the element (to check if focus indicator is visible). Note: The link is automatically injected and focused by the test.
- [`When I set the viewport to <width>px by <height>px`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Sets both the width and height of the viewport in the browser.
- [`When I focus "<selector>" using the arrow keys`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element inside a component using arrow keys. For example: Components which use a roving tabindex pattern. Note: Will activate :focus-visible) styles.

## Assertions

- [`Then it should have a visible focus indicator`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element has a visible focus indicator. Note: Only checks for for outline or box-shadow.
- [`Then its focus indicator should be fully visible`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks the focus indicator is fully visible.
- [`Then it should not have any part of its focus indicator covered by "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks that a named element does not cover any part of the focus indicator.

## Example

```gherkin
Background:
  Given I load the sample "http://localhost:8081/accordion/examples/default"

@2.4.12 @aaa @automatic
Rule: 2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced), Level AAA
  Scenario Outline: The triggers and the Show all sections button are fully visible when they receive keyboard focus
    When I focus "<element>" using a keyboard
    Then it should have a visible focus indicator
    And its focus indicator should be fully visible
    Examples:
      | element                                         |
      | .tl-accordion__toggle-all                       |
      | .tl-accordion__section:nth-of-type(1) > button |
```
